inputs.text: It’s understandable that he misses the appearance of US-China unity, but international agreement isn’t an end in itself. A government’s first duty is to its own people, families, and national sovereignty—not to preserve a global treaty simply to satisfy diplomatic expectations. Trump’s withdrawal may disappoint advocates of the Paris Agreement, but standing apart from an international consensus can be a defense of national accountability, not a rejection of responsibility.

output.main_topic: Trump’s withdrawal and the priority of national sovereignty over international consensus
subtopics: Government responsibility to its own people
output.narrative_frame: Argues that national sovereignty and accountability can outweigh the expectation of international consensus.
opinions: International agreement isn’t an end in itself.
A government’s first duty is to its own people, families, and national sovereignty.
